name: Blind writing panel, 30 prompts
seeds: Fixed paired seed per prompt, recorded in the encrypted label manifest
labeling: A/B assignments randomized per prompt with balanced model exposure overall and within one case per genre
generation: First returned completion retained, including length or formatting failures
word_count: Python str.split whitespace count of the complete returned text
line_count: Nonempty lines of the complete returned text, including any generated heading
poem_instruction: Write a poem in English, up to 16 lines.
prose_instruction: Write a short prose piece in English, 300 to 500 words.
